turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello. I paid extra for a router to arrive quickly, but it showed up five days later. I want the delivery charge back.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can look at that for you. Can I take the postcode and the last four digits of your account reference?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It’s RH2 8PL, and 4831. I called on Monday and was told somebody would sort it out.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. One moment while I bring up the order.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I paid twelve pounds for the faster option. I work from home. I had to buy mobile data in the meantime.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the £12 charge and that the router arrived later than the date on the order. Sorry about the inconvenience.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So can you refund it now? The agent I spoke to on Monday made it sound straightforward.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can put this through to billing for review. They would normally send a response by email.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But the delivery date is right there. Why does it need another review?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand the frustration. I’m just trying to make sure it goes to the right team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Do you need anything else from me? I sent a screenshot already.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No, I can see the delivery confirmation. Let me enter a note.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will the twelve pounds be back on my account by Friday?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can’t promise Friday. The billing team will confirm what they decide.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So nothing has actually changed since Monday?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ve made a new enquiry and marked that you called again today.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you check whether there is another way? I’m not disputing the whole order, just the delivery fee.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I don’t want to give you incorrect information. I’ll ask the billing team to look at the charge.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: All right, but I’m going to have to call again if nobody gets back to me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The reference is BQ-418. I’m sorry I couldn’t resolve it during this call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi. My router delivery was five days late, and I paid twelve pounds for express delivery. I want that charge returned.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll check the order and the delivery information. Could you confirm the postcode and account reference ending?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: RH2 8PL. The reference ends 7712. I asked about this earlier in the week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I can see the delivery date and the additional £12 charge.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Then can you take it off the bill now? That’s all I’m asking.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can document the complaint and refer it for a billing review.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why would billing need to decide? You can see it missed the date.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I agree the delivery record doesn’t match the promised day. I’m not able to adjust the fee on this screen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could a supervisor do it?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can ask for the complaint to be reviewed, but I can’t give you a yes on the charge today.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That sounds exactly like what the agent I spoke to earlier this week told me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry you’re having to repeat this. I’ll include the order dates and the charge in the referral.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does that mean another three days waiting?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The stated response time is three working days. I can’t shorten it from here.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: This was meant to be guaranteed delivery. Does that word mean anything?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand why you’re asking. The complaint will be recorded as a missed delivery commitment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can I have something in writing that you’ve done that?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. I’ll email the reference, BR-226, while we’re on the call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have the email. I’m still disappointed there’s no refund.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I appreciate that. I’m sorry I can’t give you an immediate resolution.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I received your HomePlus offer but I’m confused about the price. The email looks like twenty-nine pounds is only for three months.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can help. Which package did you select?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: HomePlus, the faster one. The salesperson said the price was competitive, but the small text mentions thirty-six.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: One moment. I’m looking at the package information.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I just don’t want to find a bigger bill after I switch.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The package information I have in front of me lists HomePlus at £29 a month.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is that for the whole contract, or is that the introductory rate?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It’s the monthly rate on the guidance page. You should be paying £29.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The email says “months one to three” beside that number. Can you check?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I see why you’re asking. The details I’m reading don’t mention a different rate after month three.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you open my actual quote? It has a reference on the email.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The general package details are the ones we use to explain the service. I don’t think there’s a separate price for you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But there’s definitely a £36 amount under the main price.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It may be an old illustration on the email. I’d expect the £29 amount to apply.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: “Expect” isn’t the same as guaranteed. Can you send me confirmation?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll send the package information link. That is the page I’m using.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’m not signing until this is clear. I’ve been caught by introductory prices before.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That’s understandable. Would you like me to arrange a sales callback?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, and please ask them specifically about the change after month three.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll note that question. The callback reference is SC-504.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello. I booked an installation for Friday afternoon, and the portal still says Friday. A text this morning says Saturday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry that’s confusing. Let me search the booking.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The booking reference is IN-9031. I’ve already taken Friday off work.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. I’m seeing an appointment for Saturday on the information available to me.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But I’m looking at Friday right now. Was it moved without asking me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can’t see the reason for any change in this view.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could Friday still be right?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I would work on the assumption that Saturday is the date, although I don’t want to mislead you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell me whether an engineer has actually been assigned?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The screen doesn’t give me a confirmed engineer name yet.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That leaves me with two different days and no idea when to be home.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I can send a request to scheduling to confirm the slot.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: How long will they take? The appointment might be tomorrow.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll mark it urgent, but I can’t guarantee a reply today.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you at least confirm which date your system is displaying while we’re speaking?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It currently shows Saturday in the booking summary.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: All right. Please make sure they call me rather than just sending another automatic text.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll request a call. The enquiry number is INQ-9031.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks. I need a definite answer before I rearrange work again.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood. I’m sorry we couldn’t confirm it during the call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’m calling because someone said a technician would ring me back yesterday within two hours. Nobody called.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry you’ve been waiting. Can I take your account number so I can see the previous note?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It ends 5628. I was on the phone for nearly half an hour yesterday about the connection dropping.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the note about a callback. Was it meant to be to this mobile number?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes. I left it on charge beside me all afternoon. There were no missed calls.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I’m checking the contact history.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: This is the third day I’ve had to restart the router for work calls.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That sounds disruptive. I can see the issue hasn’t been marked as resolved.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Did the previous adviser actually book the callback?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There’s a note saying one was offered, but I can’t see a completed callback in the contact history.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So I waited for something that wasn’t even arranged?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can’t confirm exactly what happened from the note alone.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you get somebody today, please? I can’t keep taking time off to phone.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll request the earliest available technical call and ask for a confirmation message.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell me the time rather than just “today”?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The available appointment shown here is between two and four this afternoon.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Fine, I’ll be available then. Will you check it has actually gone through?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. I’m waiting for the confirmation number before we finish.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: All right, I’ve got a text now.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The new callback reference is CB-620. I’m sorry about the extra delay.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need to know why my internet installation has been moved twice. First Tuesday, then Friday, and now the message says next Wednesday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry. I’ll check the appointment history. May I confirm the address postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: AB12 4XE. We moved in on Saturday and I’ve been using my phone for meetings.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I can see several appointment changes on the order.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Nobody called. The dates just changed overnight.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see notification messages were sent, but no completed installation visit.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you put me back on Friday? I’ve arranged for someone to be home.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me check the live slots. Friday isn’t available for this area now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Someone offered it yesterday. I can’t keep rearranging my working week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. The earliest slot displayed is next Wednesday morning.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Are you certain that one won’t disappear too?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can confirm what the schedule currently shows, but I can’t promise it won’t change.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you personally book an engineer?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can send an urgent scheduling request, but engineer allocation is handled separately.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will that request hold Wednesday at least?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It won’t hold an additional slot. I can note your preferred date and request confirmation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It feels like every adviser is telling me the same thing and nobody can fix it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry you’ve had to contact us again. I’ll put the full history into the request.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please send the current date in writing, so I have something to refer to.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll send the appointment summary and the escalation reference, IN-718.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I’m locked out of my account. I just answered security questions in the automated menu.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll need to go through verification. What’s the first line of your billing address?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Twenty-eight Mill Lane. I already said that to the recorded system.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That’s fine. What’s your last payment amount?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It was £41.50, I think. Is this going to take long? I need to check whether the direct debit went through.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We have questions to ask before we can do anything.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I understand security, but why does it ask me twice?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It’s the process. There’s no point arguing with me about it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’m not arguing. I’m asking why. I’ve got an overdue notice and I’m worried.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Right. What was the name of the first package you had with us?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I don’t remember that. I’ve been a customer for seven years.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Well, I need an answer to finish the checks.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you give me another question? Or explain how to reset the account?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Not until the verification is done.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: You sound as though this is my fault. I’ve just been trying to get into the account.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I didn’t say it was your fault. I’m following the steps on the screen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you at least tell me what I should do next if I can’t remember that old package?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can send a secure recovery link to the registered email address.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please do. I wish we’d started there.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ve sent it. Check your inbox in a few minutes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello, I can’t open the billing page. It just keeps taking me back to sign-in.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm the account email address?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It’s the one ending at westmail dot example. I’ve already reset the password twice.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay. What happens after you enter the new password?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The loading circle spins, then it says “session expired.”

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you try a different browser?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I did, on my laptop and phone. Are you still there?

turns.speaker: TRANSCRIPT NOTE
turns.text: [8 seconds without intelligible speech]

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello? I can hear something, but I can’t make out what you’re saying.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: ... account details ... let me check.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, that broke up. What am I supposed to check?

turns.speaker: TRANSCRIPT NOTE
turns.text: [6 seconds without intelligible speech]

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: This is really difficult. I’ve been trying to get my invoice for two days.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you hear me now?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, for the moment. Did you find anything on the account?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The page ... I can raise a web support ticket.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please do. Can you tell me how I’ll receive the invoice in the meantime?

turns.speaker: TRANSCRIPT NOTE
turns.text: [4 seconds of unintelligible audio]

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hello? I don’t know if you heard the question.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll send you a link by email.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is that the link to the bill or a support form?

turns.speaker: TRANSCRIPT NOTE
turns.text: [Call capture ends; disconnection direction unknown]

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need this broadband fault escalated. This is the fourth time I’ve phoned about the line dropping.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry it’s still happening. I can see the earlier contacts. Can I confirm when it last disconnected?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: About ten minutes ago. It goes down for a few minutes then comes back.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I’ll add that to the notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Last time they told me to reset the router. I’ve done that repeatedly. I need somebody more technical.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I can put in a request for the specialist team to look at the repeated fault.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please don’t just write another note. Has the escalation actually been sent?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m updating the case now. Give me a moment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’ve already lost two video meetings this week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sorry about that. I’ve added the repeated disconnections and your request for escalation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does that mean a specialist gets it rather than first-line support?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, the case is marked for escalation in the notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you give me a specialist case number?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The customer case reference remains FC-1447. You can quote that when you call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’m asking because the last two people promised the same thing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I appreciate that. I’ve put the details in and asked for the specialist team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: When should I hear back?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’d expect a response within two working days, but I can’t guarantee an appointment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: All right. I’ll wait for the email, but please make sure it’s not another normal support case.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ve recorded your request. Sorry again for the disruption.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need this broadband fault escalated. This is the fourth time I’ve phoned about the line dropping.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m sorry it’s still happening. I can see the earlier contacts. Can I confirm when it last disconnected?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: About ten minutes ago. It goes down for a few minutes then comes back.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I’ll add that to the notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Last time they told me to reset the router. I’ve done that repeatedly. I need somebody more technical.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I’ll try to send this to the specialist team for the repeated fault.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please don’t just write another note. Has the escalation actually been sent?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’m working through the request. One moment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’ve already lost two video meetings this week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sorry about that. The request is not going through on the first attempt; I’m checking the case information.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does that mean a specialist gets it rather than first-line support?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Not yet. I’m going to try again, and if it still doesn’t submit I’ll record the issue for the operations team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you give me a specialist case number?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can’t give you one until the system accepts the request. The existing customer case is FC-1592.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I’m asking because the last two people promised the same thing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. The system hasn’t accepted the specialist request. I can file a review note but I don’t want to tell you it has been escalated.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: When should I hear back?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can ask for a review within two working days, though I can’t promise a specialist appointment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: All right. Please tell me if there’s no progress.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I’ll send a summary of what was and wasn’t submitted. I’m sorry we couldn’t finish it today.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I was charged twenty pounds to activate my line, but the connection itself was several days late.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me find the original activation order. Can you give me the reference on the bill?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It ends 0842. I only noticed the extra charge when I opened this month’s statement.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. The account is open. Yes, the activation happened after the estimated date.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Do you have the charge in front of you?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, it is listed as activation, twenty pounds.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I was told the delay was at your end. Can you take it off now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can put a question through to billing for someone to check.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would that mean a credit today or another email in a week?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It means they will look at the circumstances and come back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I already gave this information on the website yesterday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a website message but it does not show the outcome yet.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there a standard process for reversing a charge like this?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There are different processes depending on the account. I do not want to promise anything.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you at least explain why it was applied?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is an activation fee. I can note that the activation was delayed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I would rather not have to repeat this a third time.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I have added the note and the new enquiry number.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you read that number out?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is BE-384. Sorry I cannot close the issue on this call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I have two reconnection fees after the outage on Tuesday. Why am I being billed for that?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am checking your prepaid account. Could you confirm the last four digits?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: 9306. There was a recorded outage all afternoon; I did not disconnect the line myself.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see two reconnection entries, yes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Are you able to remove them?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can raise a billing dispute and include the outage details.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But you can already see that the area was down.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That information is in the service history. The charges are in billing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you simply credit the money back?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot amend those entries from my screen at the moment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you put me through to someone who can?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The next step available here is a dispute reference.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It is a small amount, but this is about being charged for something I did not cause.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I am noting exactly what you have told me.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: When should I expect an answer?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Billing normally responds within five working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will the fees collect automatically before then?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: They are scheduled for the next top-up. I can flag that in the complaint.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: All right, please send the reference.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have sent BD-179 to the address on file. I am sorry this remains unresolved.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: There is a sixty-pound charge for a router I posted back last week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will check the return. Do you have the barcode from the return label?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Not anymore. The driver collected the parcel and I only have the tracking link.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The guidance asks for the barcode, so that is the first thing I need.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I can tell you the tracking number if that helps.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just a moment while I check the account notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The tracking website says delivered to your returns centre on Thursday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the charge but not a completed return on this page.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you search by tracking number instead?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am following the return instructions shown here.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But I do not have the barcode. Surely there is another way.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can ask the warehouse to investigate.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: How long would that take?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The usual turnaround is five working days.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: And the sixty pounds is due tomorrow?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is on your next statement, yes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Then I will be charged for something you already have.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I appreciate the concern. I will make it clear the tracking says delivered.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please send me the reference number.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is RT-561. I cannot remove the charge until it is confirmed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I cancelled after you changed my contract, and now there is a forty-five-pound exit charge.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me open the account. Can you confirm the date you requested cancellation?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The fourteenth. My confirmation email says there should not be a fee.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have the cancellation page. It is showing an early-exit charge.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That is what I am disputing. The confirmation says something different.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I agree those do not match. I will note the email.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you change the fee before it comes out?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot change that charge directly from this view.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there a way to challenge the system entry?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can put the two records through to billing for review.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The cancellation date was entered by your team, not me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the date in the contact history.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you check the plan I was on when I cancelled?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There are several plan changes listed, and the billing page still shows the charge.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I do not want a collections notice while you look at it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will add the payment concern to the case.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would a supervisor be able to investigate now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am not certain what they could authorise from this screen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please at least confirm you have logged the contradiction.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. The case is CX-204. We will write to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I am calling about a visit charge. Nobody came to my house, but I have been billed thirty pounds.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me open the appointment. Can you confirm the date you expected the engineer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Last Thursday, sometime between eight and midday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see an engineer visit listed for that day.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does it say anybody actually turned up?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The summary has a completed status, but I cannot see much detail on this page.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I was in the house until eleven. After that I picked up my daughter.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Was someone else home after eleven?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My partner might have been back before midday. I would need to ask.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Were there any calling cards or messages?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I did not find a card. There may have been a missed call, I am not sure.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will check for a contact note.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell me what the charge is meant to cover?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is listed as a completed attendance, but I cannot verify the timing right now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I do not want to pay for a visit that did not happen.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That is understandable. I can request the detailed job record.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will it be removed today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot establish that from what we have on this call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please investigate and email me what you find.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will open investigation EV-208 and explain what information is missing.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My renewal bill does not show the loyalty discount I thought I agreed to.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you tell me when you discussed the offer?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: About a month ago when I renewed on the phone. I did not write down the adviser’s name.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me look at the renewal notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: They said it would be cheaper than my previous plan.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a new plan and an offer reference, but the discount is not applied.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you add it now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I need to establish which offer was accepted.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I thought that had been settled already.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see why you would expect it on the bill.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: There was also a message in my account saying it was pending.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Would you be able to forward that message if you still have it?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I can try; I deleted some old emails last week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We can investigate using the notes we do have.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So was the agent wrong, or was the discount not put on?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot confirm either explanation from these records.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: What happens if the recording is missing?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We will tell you what we can substantiate and what options remain.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please do not just close the complaint.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will leave it open under RD-406 while the offer history is checked.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I signed up for your Studio plan and need to know the upload speed for sending videos.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Sure. What does your plan confirmation say?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The email says twenty megabits for upload. Is that the limit?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am looking at the Studio product page now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I was told it would be suitable for large files.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is an unlimited plan, so your uploads should not be restricted.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But I can see a separate twenty-megabit line in the agreement.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That is likely the standard estimate, not a ceiling.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you look at that clause specifically?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am confident the unlimited description applies to the whole service.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The clause looks important. I do not want to choose the wrong package.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. Studio is one of our more flexible products.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would the Business package be different for upload?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It might be. We would need to compare the packages.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Then how can we be sure Studio has no upload limit?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am basing that on the current product information.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you email the exact term you relied on?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can send you the general product page.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need a definite answer before installation.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have added a note that you asked about upload speed. Anything else?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I am moving house and want to know how much notice I need to cancel my broadband.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me bring up the contract. What is your account ending?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: 6419. I am hoping to cancel at the end of next week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see that you are on a standard twelve-month agreement.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I read something about giving thirty days. Is that right?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: For most accounts a week should be sufficient to notify us.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Are you sure? I do not want another month’s charge.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: If you request the cancellation now, the team can arrange the date.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But does it have to be thirty days before that?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I do not think you need that much notice for a move.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you confirm the notice clause?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will note the moving date so cancellations can look at it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need to budget for the last payment.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood. Your final bill is issued after the service ends.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That does not tell me if there will be another month.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The cancellations team will calculate the final amount.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Should I wait until they reply before scheduling movers?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I would submit the request now, then follow up if the date changes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please send something confirming the rules.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can send the contract link and today’s enquiry reference.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I received a message saying my line would move to the new network on Wednesday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can check what our system is showing. May I have your service postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: BL3 6HA. The website still shows Monday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: One moment. I am opening the migration record.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Which date should I tell my employer? I need internet for a video interview.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The service status currently lists Monday as the completion date.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That would mean it has already happened, but the router still says pending.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I will read the current service status rather than guess.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Did the date change overnight?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot see an update after the entry for Monday.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could engineering confirm it?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can submit a query, although I cannot reach the installation scheduler directly.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So should I rely on Monday or Wednesday?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The only confirmed date I can see here is Monday.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That does not sound confirmed if it has passed.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You are right to question it. I will log the difference between your message and the dashboard.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will someone call me before the work happens?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can request a service notification.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please do, I cannot keep changing my plans.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is logged under MG-228. I am sorry I cannot reconcile the messages now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My direct debit was moved to the twenty-fourth, but the app is still warning me about the eighteenth.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can review the payment screen. What is your account reference?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It ends 2289. The change was confirmed last Friday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. The payment summary I can access says eighteenth.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does that mean the change was cancelled?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot see evidence of cancellation on this page.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have a text giving the twenty-fourth and a reference number.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you read the reference so I can include it?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: PX-201. Will the bank collect on the eighteenth?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Our summary still shows that date, but I do not want to mislead you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you see the payment processor record?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Not directly from this customer screen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Should I keep the funds available twice?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I would rather get this reconciled than advise you based on conflicting dates.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there someone who can do that today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can flag it to payments operations as time-sensitive.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please mention I do not want a missed-payment notice.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, I will include that and your confirmation reference.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you email what you checked?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Of course. I will send the case number PD-319 shortly.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The upgrade page says thirty-two pounds, but the offer you emailed is thirty-nine.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will check the PlusMax price. Have you got the quote number?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, Q-910. Which price would I actually pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The product help page says thirty-two pounds.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is that still current? The offer arrived today.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: As far as this page shows, thirty-two is the standard charge.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you open my actual quote instead?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the product description, and it has the lower figure.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But the email has a quote number, not just a general price.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It could include a different package configuration.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would you check before I accept?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I think thirty-two is what you should expect, based on the guidance.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I do not want to rely on a guess.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I appreciate that. You can raise a pricing enquiry.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why can we not resolve it while I am on the phone?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have given you the information I have at present.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Then please do not mark the price as confirmed.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will note that the email and online information differ.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: What should I do with the deadline in the email?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I suggest waiting for a written response before placing the order.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I signed up believing my package included a static IP address, but support says it does not.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I check the account and see which features are enabled?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, the account ends 1534. I spoke to sales a few weeks ago.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see your broadband plan, but not the original feature discussion.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I asked because I use a work connection from home.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That makes sense. The feature is usually listed separately.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Your salesperson said the plan would suit me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Did they mention a static IP specifically, or the general business features?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I think they said static. I do not remember the exact wording.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Okay. I will look for an offer confirmation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I cannot find the email now; I may have used my other address.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There is no confirmed static-IP selection in this view.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So did I misunderstand, or was I told the wrong thing?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot establish that from this account summary alone.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you at least tell me what getting it now would involve?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can send the current options and ask sales to verify eligibility.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will you record that the original promise is disputed?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, and I will distinguish what you recall from what our records show.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please put everything in writing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will send enquiry SI-905 and a link to the current product terms.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I registered for priority support last month. My connection has been down since yesterday morning.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry. Can I confirm your account and priority reference?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The account ends 4116, and the priority number is PS-79.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I can see the priority marker on the account.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I was hoping an engineer could come today.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will look at available appointments.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell me what the earliest one is?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the booking window loading. One moment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Do you need any other information from me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No, your contact details are already recorded.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is the appointment booked?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have noted that you need an urgent visit.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That sounds like a note, not a booking.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will ask scheduling to contact you with a time.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: How long will that take?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: They usually get back within one working day.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I thought priority meant something faster.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand, and I have highlighted the priority status.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will I receive a confirmation message?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You should receive an update from scheduling. The enquiry number is PS-310.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My installation was meant to happen this week, but I have just been moved to next Thursday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me check the available engineer appointments for your postcode.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: There were some bad storms, but nobody told me I might lose the booking.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry the notice came late. The calendar is showing a later appointment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you fit me into a cancellation tomorrow?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will check the queue for any released visits.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have already taken a day off for the original appointment.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, I can see your original booking and the date change.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: What caused it?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I do not have a precise field-work reason in the customer view.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you reserve any slot sooner?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No earlier appointments are currently available on the booking calendar.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you put me on a waiting list?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. I can register you for a cancellation opening.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will it be automatic if one appears?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Dispatch will send a message if an earlier slot is released.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I wish someone had told me before I changed my shifts.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You should have received clearer notice. I will register that complaint.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please send the date you can actually confirm.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Your confirmed booking remains Thursday. I will send that and waitlist reference WL-82.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I waited all morning for the engineer. The appointment window finished an hour ago.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am checking the job now. I am sorry no one has arrived.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: You texted me at one o’clock saying the appointment had moved.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a revised date in the booking record.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But I was already at home waiting by then.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. The update should have reached you earlier.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: When did you know there was a problem?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There was an alert earlier today, but I did not send your update straightaway.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why not? I could have gone to work.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I was working through several rescheduled visits and left yours in the queue.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Was the original booking wrong as well?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot confirm why dispatch moved it from this screen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can someone tell me whether the engineer is still coming?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The revised booking is for Monday, not today.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I cannot lose another day’s wages.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I will ask for the circumstances to be reviewed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you make sure I get notice if anything changes again?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can add email and text alerts and check both contacts.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please confirm it while I am on the line.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Both alerts are recorded now. I apologise for the delay in telling you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The fault ticket has been open four days, and I have not had an update since Monday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the repair ticket. Can you confirm the account postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: LE5 2GN. Yesterday someone said parts were being checked.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That is what the last note says. I will look for a newer update.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Do you have a date now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a revised estimate, but the technical team still has work to complete.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why has nobody sent the estimate to me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry. The update may not have reached the notification queue.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you send it yourself?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will arrange for a written status update.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell me whether it is a line fault or router fault?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The note mentions equipment being replaced, but I cannot confirm the specific diagnosis.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is the replacement actually available?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I do not have the warehouse record in this view.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So what should I plan around?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I would treat the estimate as provisional while the engineers complete the work.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you at least put that in the email?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, I will note the provisional estimate and that you requested written confirmation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you read back the contact address?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is your registered email ending in @mail.example. The case is FR-518.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I booked a remote test call for half past ten and no one contacted me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will look at the booking record. Was the call to the mobile ending 8063?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes. I was waiting, although I went into a meeting briefly at eleven.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The schedule says there was a call planned at ten thirty.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does it say somebody called?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a scheduled entry, but there is no result next to it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My phone has no missed call in the history.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could unknown numbers have been filtered?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Possibly. I do sometimes have spam screening turned on.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will note that, though it does not tell us whether a call was made.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could the engineer have called the house phone?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I do not see another number listed for this appointment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Did anyone mark the job complete?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It is still open. I cannot see a completed test result.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: So who failed to do what?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We cannot determine that from the records available on this call.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can we avoid the same problem next time?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. We can agree a time and confirm the calling number in advance.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Tomorrow afternoon would work.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have requested two thirty and will send a confirmation text.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Our installation was cancelled because someone said they could not get into the building.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can look into that. Was it for the office on Canal Street?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes. The building manager says no engineer turned up at reception.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The engineer note says there was no access to the riser cupboard.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Those are two different stories. Who is responsible?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot verify either account from this appointment summary.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Did the engineer try calling the building manager?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I do not have a contact attempt listed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I provided the building manager’s number in the booking form.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a number, but not whether it was used.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Our team cleared the room and waited from nine.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: What was the confirmed engineer window?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Between nine and noon, according to your booking email.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you tell if they came at eleven thirty?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No time of arrival appears in this record.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Will you rebook before checking that?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I suggest confirming the access instructions and contact person first.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Please ask both the engineer and reception what happened.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I will request their accounts and the missing visit timeline.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Please send a summary so we know what to change.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I am trying to reconnect my router, but the instructions do not make sense to me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You need to release the DHCP lease and reinitialise the WAN interface.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sorry, I do not know what those words mean.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The issue is that the WAN session has not negotiated properly.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you explain what button I should press?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: First you need to verify that the upstream lease has been renewed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I am not very technical. I just want the internet back.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, and the procedure I am describing will help identify the problem.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is it the small black button at the back?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Not necessarily. That is a reset control, which is not the same as renewing the session.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I am getting more confused, not less.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You should access the router management interface.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Where do I find that?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It will be on your local gateway address.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you please talk me through it slowly?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have explained the general procedure; the manual has the detailed steps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you email instructions that use everyday words?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can send you the troubleshooting guide.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will that guide show pictures?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It has some diagrams. Please call again if you need more assistance.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My connection keeps dropping and I need someone to understand when it happens.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Have you restarted the router?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have, but the problem is usually in the evenings when—

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Right, restarting is the first step. Have you tried it today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes. I was trying to explain that it works fine in the morning.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You will need a line test. I can send a link.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you let me finish? The test ran clean yesterday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: If it is clean, the issue might be inside your house.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The lights on the router go red before it cuts out.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. Please use the link I send.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The last agent asked me to log the times. I have them here.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That is useful, but I have a number of calls waiting.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would you like the times now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You can put them in the online form.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I spent an hour doing that yesterday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It might save time if you resubmit the details.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there a ticket number I can use instead?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can create a new one, yes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you confirm it includes what I just said?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have recorded intermittent connectivity. Ticket FT-612.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I cannot get into my account, and the verification code only comes through the app I cannot open.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry. Let me check what recovery options your account allows.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have a visual impairment and normally use telephone verification.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. I will look for the assisted option.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Do you have a way to send the code by telephone?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The screen is currently asking for the code from the app.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That is the step I cannot complete.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand the problem. I do not want to ask you to repeat an inaccessible step.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you verify me through my security questions?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am looking for another method, but none appears in this view.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does your accessibility team have a special line?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can request their involvement and explain what is blocking you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will they be able to reset the account today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot guarantee a reset until they review it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have bills due and cannot get to them.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can ask billing to send an accessible statement while this is investigated.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would you note that the app-only method is the issue?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. I will record it specifically rather than describing this as a forgotten password.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thank you. Could you email what happens next?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will send case AC-711 and request an accessible-format reply.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have been transferred twice already and each person asks for my address again.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry for the repetition. You are with technical support now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I started in billing because the charge relates to the fault.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. Before I access the fault record, I need to verify the account.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I gave my postcode and password to the previous department.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I appreciate that. I cannot see their verification result in my workspace.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you just read the notes they made?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a billing referral reference, but not the full discussion.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have explained the router problem three times.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you give me the fault number so I can try to pick it up?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: F-334. Is there a way to keep everything under one case?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can connect this technical ticket to the billing reference in my notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will the next team still ask me the same questions?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot promise they will see this verification result.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That is not very good customer service.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You are right to expect a smoother process. I will record your feedback.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can someone own the issue instead of sending me around?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can request a case owner to coordinate the next steps.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please put that request in the record.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have done so under CO-224 and will send the confirmation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have been stuck in your phone menu for twenty minutes. It keeps sending me back to the beginning.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry. What option were you trying to select?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The one for assisted access. I use a screen reader.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Our menu can be difficult when there is a lot of traffic.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It did not matter what option I pressed; it read the same choices again.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Now you have reached support. What do you need help with?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need somebody to go through the password recovery with me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: You should choose the accessibility option in the menu next time.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That is what I have been saying: it never connects me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am telling you the usual route for those requests.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you book me a call with the right person instead?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can put a general note on the account.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Would that mean an actual appointment?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It means the request is visible if you call again.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I cannot keep going through the same menu.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I appreciate it has been frustrating.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please tell me how somebody will contact me.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot provide a time right now, but the team can review the note.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I need this fixed so I can pay my bill.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will mark the contact as urgent. Reference AS-507.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I want to make a complaint about how this call started.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry to hear that. Can you explain what concerned you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Before the line cut out, I felt I was being spoken over.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry that is how it came across.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I did not hear the whole sentence because the audio broke up.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I noticed the connection dropped briefly as well.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I think you said I should stop asking questions.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That is not what I intended, but I cannot reconstruct exactly what was heard.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will the recording show it?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can request a quality review of the available recording.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: What if it does not include the beginning?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Then we will need to be careful about what can be established.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I did not call to argue; I need help with my account.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Understood. I can continue the account query and record the complaint separately.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell me which part of the call is saved?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot see the recording coverage from this screen.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please do not dismiss the complaint just because it is difficult to verify.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will record both your account and the uncertainty around the audio.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you send me a reference?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes. It is QA-416. You will receive a written acknowledgement.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have done your speed tests three times this week. The connection still drops during work calls.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can review the tests. Can I take the fault reference?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The ticket is FN-694. The last two advisers said to keep testing.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I see repeated failed results. I will request technical escalation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thank you. Will a network engineer look at it now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am opening the escalation page.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you confirm what has to happen for it to be sent?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I need to add the test dates and the fault symptoms.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: The dates are Monday, Wednesday and today.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have the test history. It should be enough to proceed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will you give me an engineer reference?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will send a confirmation when the escalation is processed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you check that it has actually gone?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have recorded the urgency in your account notes.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: That does not sound like confirmation.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The specialist team will be able to see the contact.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Are they expecting a new escalation, though?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have flagged it so it can be reviewed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please send me exactly what was done.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Your contact reference is CN-780. I will ask the team to follow up.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I was told this fault would finally be sent to network engineering today.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me open the fault. Have you got the reference number?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: NE-801. I have been without stable broadband since the upgrade.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the fault history and the priority marker.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you escalate it while I wait?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am entering the technical fault code now.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is it accepted?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The form is showing a validation message. Let me retry.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: What does that mean for my case?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: It has not completed the submission yet.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you try a different code?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I need to use the code recorded against the fault; choosing another would be inaccurate.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is somebody able to do it manually?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can log the escalation failure and ask operations to investigate.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: But the service is still not working.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand the impact, and I am marking the issue urgent.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will an engineer definitely receive it today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot promise that until the submission is accepted.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please make sure there is a trace of this call.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have saved the error report ER-441 and your original fault reference.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I asked for a supervisor review last week and I still have no response.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will check the complaint history. Can you give me the reference?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: CM-118. I have called more than once about the billing error.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Yes, I can see two previous complaints.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you put it through to a supervisor now?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will try the escalation route.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does it work?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am getting a message that the queue is temporarily unavailable.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there another way to send the request?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can record an urgent note and try again when the system responds.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will anyone monitor the note?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The complaints team has access to the account.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you send them an email while we speak?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am not sure whether that is the normal process for a complaint like this.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I do not want another note that sits there.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand. I have marked it as a priority.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you give me a date for supervisor contact?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot confirm a date until the referral goes through.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please state that I asked for an actual escalation.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will record your request and the queue error under CM-119.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: My mother’s medical alarm uses the connection and the repair appointment is next Tuesday.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I am sorry. Let me look at the repair booking and account status.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: We registered for priority assistance a while ago.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see an older priority-registration note.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Should that not mean we can be seen sooner?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: The booking screen is showing standard appointment options.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Could you check whether our priority status has expired?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see the registry note, but the scheduler is not showing that status.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you tell someone that these records disagree?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can put a note on the appointment.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there an urgent team I should speak to?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There are specialist teams, but the booking page is what I have open.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: We need an answer today, not next week.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand, and I will flag the potential safety concern.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you confirm it has been referred to the right person?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot confirm a specialist booking at this point.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Is there anything more you can do while I am here?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will add the details for the scheduling team to review.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please tell me what the next step is.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Expect a message about the appointment. The contact reference is PR-632.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I asked to cancel my service last month but I am still being billed.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can look at the account. Do you remember how you made the request?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I used the message form on your website, I think on the twelfth.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see a contact event but not the message itself.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I have a screenshot of what I typed.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you send that to the case email?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I will, but it does not show a confirmation number.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. I will check whether there is a processed cancellation.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It looks like there was not. Did someone just ignore my request?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot tell what happened to the original message from this summary.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Does that mean I have to pay another month?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I do not want to decide that until the evidence is reviewed.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can the system tell you whether it was delivered?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will request the contact-platform records if they are available.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I entered the account reference when I sent it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: That may help the search. I will include the details.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will you at least stop the service today?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: We can discuss a new confirmed request without prejudging the earlier one.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please make sure the old billing complaint stays open.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I have linked it to new investigation CN-342.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Our small office has had no stable connection overnight. I was told it was going to network engineering.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can you share the fault number you received?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: One email says BZ-602 and another says BZ-620.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me check both references; they may point to related records.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Did someone actually send the case to an engineer?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can see contact notes, but not an acknowledgement from engineering.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Was the escalation rejected?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I cannot see a rejection message either.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why did we get two numbers?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: There may be a duplicate, but I do not want to assume that.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: I spoke to someone after midnight. Can you listen to that call?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will check whether a recording was retained.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: We need a repair plan before the shop opens.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I understand the urgency. I will ask operations to trace both tickets.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Can you send a new escalation rather than waiting?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I can open a verified urgent referral while keeping the original case trace open.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Will that prove what happened overnight?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: No, it addresses the current fault while we investigate the earlier attempt.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Please keep those as separate questions in the report.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I will do that and send reference UR-229.
